intro: One plate of nasi lemak ayam goreng has an estimated 650 kcal. Most of the calories come from the santan rice and the fried chicken, which soaks up oil, especially the skin.

variants.name: Ayam goreng berempah with rempah crumbs

diet: Yes, but this already counts as a big meal. If you have it for lunch, go lighter at dinner. The good part is the chicken protein keeps you full longer. The key is to control the chicken skin, the sambal and how often you eat it.
tips: Remove the fried chicken skin. You can save around 80-100 kcal.
Choose the breast piece if available. Higher protein, lower fat.
Ask for less rice and add cucumber or ulam on the side.

swap.name: Nasi lemak ayam bakar / ayam panggang
swap.why: The chicken isn't fried, so less oil but the protein is still high.

faq.q: Fried chicken thigh or breast, which is better for diet?
faq.a: Breast is higher in protein and lower in fat. Thigh is juicier but has more fat. Both are fine as long as you remove the skin.

faq.q: Do the fried rempah crumbs have calories?
faq.a: Yes, because the rempah is fried and absorbs oil. If you want to save calories, take less of it.

faq.q: Can I eat nasi lemak ayam goreng at night?
faq.a: Yes. The time you eat doesn't decide your weight. What matters is your total calories for the day. But if you already had a heavy lunch, go lighter at night.
